messages:
mira: Quick syncAcme Bank wants a short POC: streaming SDK -> function-calls for enrichment -> newline-delimited JSON output to their on-prem parser. They also require customer-managed KMS (on-prem HSM) + SOC2 excerpts before pilot. Any red flags?

alex: Streaming + function-calls supported. SDKs (node/python/go) can open an SSE/ws stream with function_calls enabled. The main infra blockers I see: their corporate reverse proxy strips Auth headers unless we do mTLS or provide a signed URL handshake.

judy: Pricing heads-up: streaming long outputs (they expect about 600 tokens out) will bump usage. Recommend reserved slot estimate with 20% burst margin. If they want cheaper per-token, we can suggest a quantized model variant but need to validate quality.

mira: They specified ~15 qps steady, 120 token avg input, 600 token avg output after enrichment. They also need strict single JSON object per line with fields: id, verdict, score, meta.

prashant: For schema enforcement use the structured output feature in the SDK. Example suffix we recommend: "Return exactly one JSON object per result, newline-delimited, with keys: id (string), verdict (string), score (number), meta (object). Do not include any extra text." Also enable runtime schema validation to reject nonconformant items.

raj: On the proxy side: options are 1) configure mutual TLS between their proxy and our Private ingress (cert exchange + firewall rules), or 2) let proxy pass through for a dedicated path and use ephemeral bearer tokens signed by our short-lived creds service. mTLS is more secure but longer to set up.

alex: Estimate: mTLS path ~3 days eng + 1 day infra for firewall rules + 1 day customer coordination. Ephemeral-signed-URL path ~1 day eng + docs.

mira: Security asks: SOC2 report, KMS HSM attestation, cert rotation policy, and a recent network pen-test summary. @sec-bot can you bundle a minimal packet for procurement?

sec-bot: SOC2 Type II (most recent) available. KMS: we support customer-managed keys via KMIP and cloud KMS integrations; HSM attestation depends on their vendor but we can federate or accept signed attestations. Cert rotation: default runtime cert rotation is 24h, client certs configurable. Pen-test: we can provide redacted summary and remediation notes. Logged ticket: #5678. ETA 48h for initial bundle.

judy: I'll prepare three pricing scenarios (on-demand, reserved 6mo, reserved 12mo) and include a note about switching to a quantized model to cut token costs by ~30% at potential quality tradeoffs. I'll post numbers by EOD PST.

prashant: Minimal Node SDK snippet for their engineers to try locally:

```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'rwd-stream-1', stream: true, function_calls: true });
stream.send({ content: 'Process items and return newline-delimited JSON with id,verdict,score,meta' });
stream.on('chunk', data => console.log(data));
```

mira: Great. I'll draft the kickoff invite: agenda = 1) SDK demo + runbook, 2) KMS workshop, 3) proxy cert exchange. Target: next Tuesday.

raj: I'll put together a cert-exchange checklist: cert formats (PEM), chain requirements, IP allowlist, test endpoints. Will drop it here by EOD.

judy: Pricing posted here by 17:30 PST.

mira: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll coordinate with procurement and schedule the security workshop once sec-bot posts the packet.

sec-bot: Compliance packet request created: INC-5678. Initial bundle ETA 48 hours.
